commit.message:
DTOS v1.22.12 - Team Assessment Coverage (#316)

Home and My Team now show one generation-bound projected-lineup comparison instead of generic overall-assessment placeholders. An incomplete prepared lineup retains supported coverage—for example, 9/10 slots and 1/2 comparable teams—while withholding its incomplete total and rank. Expanded text distinguishes incomplete evidence from an absent comparison and names missing slots only when supplied by the diagnostic.

Points, rank, slot coverage, population and effective qualification come from one prepared diagnostic publication. Availability changes select matching evidence; aging and failed refreshes preserve provisional labels and reasons. No optimizer/provider work is added to render the comparison. Overall grades, submitted lineups, Trade calculations/qualification, saved preferences and admission policies are unchanged.

Validation on 40cea1690943cca2ba1b99b50612c5ae6b5c68ac / tree de2827e28dea58e7174c938ba4b38930e0892bea:
- 65 focused tests; 4,066 tests and all ten canonical gates passed in clean UID1000, Python 3.14.3, actual 2 GiB/no-swap/two-CPU/network-none validation.
- All twelve hosted jobs passed, including hosted canonical, 595 Product executions, Windows/Linux tooling, security/navigation and three enforced-memory lifecycle scenarios.
- Five-case exact-source metadata preflight and 40 publisher guard tests passed.
- Guarded Actions preparation 41926751116 verified 563 hosted and 559 local canonical manifest entries, exact-source original artifact hashes, and all 16 draft attachments with byte readback before merge.

The first local full run recorded one 114.145 ms failure against an unchanged 100 ms literal fixture Home scheduling check; that endpoint does not call assessment presentation. Twenty unchanged isolated repetitions measured 4.691–7.613 ms, then a clean full canonical retry passed on the identical source. The cause of the single excursion is unproven. No threshold or application correction was used to hide it. Original failed/incomplete evidence and signed-URL-redacted transport failures are separately retained in Prior-attempts.zip; readable complete original console parts are included in the final handoff.

Preparation: https://github.com/Richarddavis47/dtos/actions/runs/41926751116
Pinned publisher/evidence: https://github.com/Richarddavis47/dtos/tree/9fad094fba9d7760786456377ebe450a6acee46d/.github/release-plans
